shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在森林里一根长着白色菌丝的朽木旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a forest beside a rotting log covered with white fungal threads, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 朽木上的真菌，也能对付毒物。
overlay: 真菌和细菌：拆解难缠的毒物

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三个图标：染料瓶、带爆炸象形图的箱子、电离辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three floating icons: a dye bottle, a crate with an explosive pictogram, and an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 污染物、炸药、放射性废物，一起看。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研在实验室里打开一个培养皿，里面长着白色菌丝
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a culture dish with fluffy white fungal growth, the lid still closed.
shots.narration: 小研在做真菌降解染料的实验。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰凑过来，伸手想把盖子掀开闻一闻
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans in close and reaches to lift the dish lid to sniff it.
shots.narration: 阿杰好奇，想掀开盖子闻一闻。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研按住盖子，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the lid down firmly and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧按住：孢子会飘出来！

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 先看这些微生物的本事，再说防护。

shots.section_title: 白腐真菌：分泌分解木质素的酶
shots.scene: 朽木切面上白色菌丝蔓延，木头变白变软
shots.prompt_en: A cut section of wood where white fungal threads spread and the wood turns pale and soft. No people.
shots.narration: 白腐真菌，专门分解木头。
overlay: 白腐真菌：分泌分解木质素的酶

shots.section_title: 白腐真菌：分泌分解木质素的酶
shots.scene: 菌丝尖端放出两种形状的小酶图标
shots.prompt_en: The tips of the fungal threads release two kinds of small enzyme icons, round and star-shaped. No people.
shots.narration: 它分泌漆酶、锰过氧化物酶，

shots.section_title: 白腐真菌：分泌分解木质素的酶
shots.scene: 酶图标把一张交错的网状结构剪开
shots.prompt_en: The enzyme icons cut apart a tangled net-like structure representing tough wood fiber. No people.
shots.narration: 拆开最难啃的木质素。

shots.section_title: 同一套酶，也能拆持久性污染物
shots.scene: 同样的酶图标转向染料瓶、农药瓶和一个变压器油桶图标
shots.prompt_en: The same enzyme icons turn toward a dye bottle, a pesticide bottle and an old transformer oil drum icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这套酶不挑食，
overlay: 同一套酶，也能拆持久性污染物

shots.section_title: 同一套酶，也能拆持久性污染物
shots.scene: 一个长期不变的污染物分子被逐步剪碎
shots.prompt_en: A long-lasting pollutant molecule, shown with a clock icon, is snipped into small pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 还能拆开长期不分解的污染物。

shots.section_title: 同一套酶，也能拆持久性污染物
shots.scene: 一池彩色污水在菌丝作用下逐渐变清
shots.prompt_en: A tray of brightly colored wastewater slowly turns clear as white fungal threads grow in it. No people.
shots.narration: 比如让染料废水褪色。

shots.section_title: 微生物能降解炸药
shots.scene: 带爆炸象形图的箱子，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A closed crate with an explosive pictogram and a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物能降解炸药吗？

shots.section_title: 微生物能降解炸药
shots.scene: 被污染的土壤剖面中，微生物聚集在颗粒旁
shots.prompt_en: A soil cross-section with tiny microbes gathering around grey contaminated particles. No people.
shots.narration: 能。被炸药污染的土壤，

shots.section_title: 微生物能降解炸药
shots.scene: 污染颗粒逐渐变小变浅
shots.prompt_en: The grey contaminated particles slowly shrink and fade. No people.
shots.narration: 可以借助微生物慢慢清理。

shots.section_title: 梭菌：把TNT的硝基还原
shots.scene: 一个杆状细菌躲在无氧的深色泥土里
shots.prompt_en: A rod-shaped bacterium sits in dark, airless mud deep underground. No people.
shots.narration: 梭菌在缺氧的环境里干活，

shots.section_title: 梭菌：把TNT的硝基还原
shots.scene: 分子模型上的几个红色小球变成蓝色小球
shots.prompt_en: On a ball-and-stick molecule model, several red balls turn into blue balls one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 把TNT上的硝基，还原成氨基。

shots.section_title: 假单胞菌和红球菌：分解RDX
shots.scene: 两种细菌图标围住另一个分子模型
shots.prompt_en: Two kinds of bacteria icons, a rod and a short branched rod, surround another molecule model. No people.
shots.narration: 恶臭假单胞菌和红球菌，
overlay: 假单胞菌和红球菌：分解RDX

shots.section_title: 假单胞菌和红球菌：分解RDX
shots.scene: 分子拆开后变成几个小气泡飘走
shots.prompt_en: The molecule breaks apart and turns into small gas bubbles floating away. No people.
shots.narration: 能把RDX分解成二氧化碳和氮气。

shots.section_title: 地杆菌：把铀变得不溶，不随水跑
shots.scene: 地下水层中，黄色的溶解颗粒随水流动
shots.prompt_en: An underground water layer where small yellow dissolved particles drift along with the flow. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性的铀溶在地下水里，会到处跑。
overlay: 地杆菌：把铀变得不溶，不随水跑

shots.section_title: 地杆菌：把铀变得不溶，不随水跑
shots.scene: 细菌贴近黄色颗粒，颗粒变成沉在底部的深色团块
shots.prompt_en: Bacteria approach the yellow particles, which turn into dark clumps that settle to the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 地杆菌把可溶的六价铀，

shots.section_title: 地杆菌：把铀变得不溶，不随水跑
shots.scene: 深色团块沉在原地，水流继续往前却不再带走它们
shots.prompt_en: The dark clumps stay in place while the water keeps flowing past without carrying them away. No people.
shots.narration: 还原成不溶的四价铀，不随水扩散。

shots.section_title: 希瓦氏菌：电子传递固定放射性金属
shots.scene: 一个细菌伸出细细的导线状结构，连到金属颗粒上
shots.prompt_en: A bacterium extends thin wire-like threads that connect to metal particles, small sparks flowing along them. No people.
shots.narration: 奥奈达希瓦氏菌，会传递电子，
overlay: 希瓦氏菌：电子传递固定放射性金属

shots.section_title: 希瓦氏菌：电子传递固定放射性金属
shots.scene: 带电离辐射标志的颗粒被固定在原地
shots.prompt_en: Particles marked with an ionizing radiation warning sign get locked in place, unable to move. No people.
shots.narration: 把放射性金属固定住。

shots.section_title: 霉菌孢子会飘：密封培养，柜内开盖
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个长满白色菌丝的培养皿旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed culture dish full of fluffy fungal growth.
shots.narration: 真菌长大了，会放出大量孢子。
overlay: 霉菌孢子会飘：密封培养，柜内开盖

shots.section_title: 霉菌孢子会飘：密封培养，柜内开盖
shots.scene: 培养皿边缘飘出一团小点，飘向旁边的其他培养皿
shots.prompt_en: A cloud of tiny dots drifts out of an opened dish toward other culture dishes nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 孢子飘出来，会污染别的培养物，

shots.section_title: 霉菌孢子会飘：密封培养，柜内开盖
shots.scene: 一个人形图标打喷嚏，旁边有孢子点
shots.prompt_en: A human outline icon sneezing, with tiny spore dots near its nose. No people.
shots.narration: 有人吸入还会过敏。

shots.section_title: 霉菌孢子会飘：密封培养，柜内开盖
shots.scene: 培养皿用封口膜封好，放进培养箱
shots.prompt_en: Culture dishes sealed around the edges with film, placed neatly into an incubator. No people.
shots.narration: 培养皿封好口再培养，

shots.section_title: 霉菌孢子会飘：密封培养，柜内开盖
shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里开盖观察
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the dish lid only inside a biosafety cabinet, wearing lab coat, gloves and goggles.
shots.narration: 要开盖，就在生物安全柜里开。

shots.section_title: 霉菌孢子会飘：密封培养，柜内开盖
shots.scene: 掀盖凑近闻的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person lifting a dish lid to sniff, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不凑近闻，环境分离的先当未知菌。

shots.section_title: 污染物标准品和溶剂：通风柜里配
shots.scene: 多个小瓶上带健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: Several small vials with blank labels and health hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 多氯联苯这类污染物，本身有毒，
overlay: 污染物标准品和溶剂：通风柜里配

shots.section_title: 污染物标准品和溶剂：通风柜里配
shots.scene: 小瓶旁边一大瓶带火焰象形图的溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Next to the vials stands a large solvent bottle with a flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 常用有机溶剂配，溶剂易燃易挥发。

shots.section_title: 污染物标准品和溶剂：通风柜里配
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里配制，拉门放低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student prepares a solution inside a fume hood with the sash lowered, wearing gloves and goggles.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里配，戴手套和护目镜。

shots.section_title: 污染物标准品和溶剂：通风柜里配
shots.scene: 废液倒进带标签的回收桶，不进水槽
shots.prompt_en: Liquid waste is poured into a labeled collection container, while a sink drain icon is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 用剩的和废液，收进危废桶。

shots.section_title: 爆炸物：学生不私取、不自试
shots.scene: 带爆炸象形图的箱子上加了一把大锁
shots.prompt_en: A crate with an explosive pictogram secured by a large padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 炸药属严格管控的爆炸物品。
overlay: 爆炸物：学生不私取、不自试

shots.section_title: 爆炸物：学生不私取、不自试
shots.scene: 网上搜索、伸手拿箱子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of searching online and reaching for a locked crate, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不得自行获取、保存或试验。

shots.section_title: 爆炸物：学生不私取、不自试
shots.scene: 老周在空白审批表上签字，旁边有公章图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews a blank approval form with an official stamp icon.
shots.narration: 相关研究由有资质的单位按规定做。

shots.section_title: 放射性样品：只在许可场所操作
shots.scene: 电离辐射标志贴在一间专用实验室门上
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation warning sign on the door of a dedicated lab. No people.
shots.narration: 铀等放射性物质，要在许可场所用。
overlay: 放射性样品：只在许可场所操作

shots.section_title: 放射性样品：只在许可场所操作
shots.scene: 普通微生物实验室门口，带辐射标志的瓶子被拦下打叉
shots.prompt_en: At the door of an ordinary microbiology lab, a bottle with an ionizing radiation warning sign is stopped with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能带进普通微生物实验室。

shots.section_title: 放射性样品：只在许可场所操作
shots.scene: 王老师给培训合格的人员发空白证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank training certificate to a trained worker.
shots.narration: 使用的人要经过培训，按规定监测。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标前：菌丝、爆炸物箱子、辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three icons: white fungal threads, a padlocked crate with an explosive pictogram, and an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 酶图标剪开木头网和污染物分子
shots.prompt_en: Enzyme icons cut apart a wood net and a pollutant molecule. No people.
shots.narration: 白腐真菌的酶，能拆持久性污染物。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 红球变蓝球，分子变气泡
shots.prompt_en: Red balls turning blue on a molecule, then another molecule turning into gas bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 梭菌、假单胞菌、红球菌降解炸药。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 颗粒沉底被固定
shots.prompt_en: Yellow particles settling and locking in place underground. No people.
shots.narration: 地杆菌、希瓦氏菌把铀固定住。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 封口培养皿、通风柜、大锁三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sealed culture dish, a fume hood, and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 孢子防飘散，溶剂进通风柜，管控物不碰。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 懂原理，守规矩，下次见！
